info.title: semantic-policy-mcp
info.description: The semantic-policy-mcp command: a gateway between an MCP host and one MCP server, which screens the server's tool results and tool definitions with SemanticPolicy policies and acts on each verdict as its gateway file says.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Runs an MCP server behind SemanticPolicy: screens its tool results and tool definitions with the gateway file's policies. The server's command line follows --: semantic-policy-mcp --gateway <path> -- <command> [<arg>...]

options.name: --gateway
options.description: The gateway file: the providers file, and each screening point's policy and actions.
